query:
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM slice) AS intervals,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT track_id) FROM slice) AS observation_tracks,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM slice WHERE name='editor_source_import_validate' AND dur>=10000000) AS held_imports,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM slice WHERE name='editor_property_edit_prepare' AND EXTRACT_ARG(arg_set_id,'args.outcome')='stale_revision') AS stale_refusals,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM slice WHERE name='editor_source_import' AND EXTRACT_ARG(arg_set_id,'args.outcome')='published') AS published_imports,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM slice WHERE name='app_start_to_presented') AS presented,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM slice WHERE name='app_start_to_gpu_complete') AS completed,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM slice g JOIN slice p ON g.ts=p.ts AND EXTRACT_ARG(g.arg_set_id,'args.runtime')=EXTRACT_ARG(p.arg_set_id,'args.runtime') AND EXTRACT_ARG(g.arg_set_id,'args.app_frame')=EXTRACT_ARG(p.arg_set_id,'args.app_frame') AND EXTRACT_ARG(g.arg_set_id,'args.render_frame')=EXTRACT_ARG(p.arg_set_id,'args.render_frame') AND EXTRACT_ARG(g.arg_set_id,'args.device_epoch')=EXTRACT_ARG(p.arg_set_id,'args.device_epoch') WHERE g.name='app_start_to_gpu_complete' AND p.name='app_start_to_presented') AS matched_frames,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM slice c LEFT JOIN slice p ON EXTRACT_ARG(c.arg_set_id,'args.parent_id')=EXTRACT_ARG(p.arg_set_id,'args.capture_id') WHERE EXTRACT_ARG(c.arg_set_id,'args.parent_id') IS NOT NULL AND p.id IS NULL) AS missing_parents,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM stats WHERE severity='error' AND value>0) AS parser_errors;
